verdict.rationale: Channel3 ships an SDK, CLI, and MCP server, so telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The optional user identifier for click and sale attribution (docs-19) and keyless MCP access (docs-9) are adjacent features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
